name: שָׁרָר
summary: Sharar the Hararite is named as the father of Ahiam in the list of David’s warriors. The parallel list calls Ahiam’s father Sacar. A connection with the word for firmness is possible, but the narrative gives no explanation of the name.

evidence.note: Ahiam is identified as the son of Sharar the Hararite.
The parallel identifies Ahiam as the son of Sacar the Hararite.
